ood_set: 8 fixed adversarial/OOD examples + 120 synthetic irrelevant texts (news/topics, explicit service mentions in non-offer context)
training: Current RuBERT and blend use original organizer labels; candidate CPU model trained on a copy of 4,854 unique descriptions + 64 all-zero synthetic negatives; source data/labels unchanged.
clean_validation: For clean ensemble, use existing grouped CV reports. The candidate noise64+RuBERT ensemble at threshold 0.55 does not yet have full five-fold clean CV; do not replace production ensemble based on OOD-only test.
latency_note: GPU-batched inference time varies with batch size and warmup; individual CPU full classification measured around p50 3.4 ms / p95 6.9 ms previously. Noise augmentation did not materially affect CPU inference throughput.

full_local_classify_latency_ms.scope: full local predict function on warm process; includes normalization, feature/tokenizer inference, thresholding and deterministic negation filter; excludes model loading, HTTP and text generation

mixed_input_stability_at_threshold_0.475.note: perturbation stability only; not a correctness metric
